_meta.description: The campaign ledger. Empty by design: one row per dated marketing action, and no row may be added except from an authorised first-party report or from a change this repository itself made and can date. No conversion rate, revenue estimate or forecast is calculated anywhere in this file.
_meta.rule: Eligible sessions, clicks and reported orders are entered only when they arrive from an Associates Central report or from the site's own opted-in endpoint (data/tracking-events.json). A null cell means 'not obtained', not zero. An empty ledger is the honest starting state; a filled one with invented numbers would be the one thing this project must never ship.
_meta.provenance_rule: Every future row carries date_utc, source (which report, or which deploy), channel and the report's own date. Where the action date and the report date differ, both are recorded.
_meta.what_is_not_here: No conversion score, no revenue forecast, no 'trending' ranking and no ROI projection. Prices, ratings and per-ASIN commission rates are withheld site-wide (F-01, F-02), so per-product revenue arithmetic is not possible even with a ledger row.

channels.definition: Sessions that arrived from a search-engine result.
channels.blocker: No search-console property and no endpoint are connected. SG-29 is an owner step recorded on the Suggestions page.

channels.definition: Sessions from a typed URL, a bookmark or another site.
channels.blocker: No endpoint is configured, so the site sees nothing server-side.

channels.definition: Clicks from one page of this site to another, measured locally by the five events in data/tracking-events.json in the visitor's own browser.
channels.blocker: Measured per visitor; there is no aggregate until the reader opts in and an endpoint exists.

cadence.publishing: One new guide per calendar week, published on a fixed weekday and recorded in the scheduled table below. A cadence is a commitment about the site's own behaviour, not a claim about traffic.
cadence.review: The ledger is reviewed on the same weekday as publication. A week with no publishable row is recorded as a missed week rather than backfilled.
cadence.why_weekly: Google's guidance rewards content written for people and updated when facts change; it does not reward volume. One well-sourced guide a week is a rate this project can hold with a single reviewer.
